title: Normalize Rest
subtitle: Cats Do It All the Time
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Are you tired? Do you need a break? Yeah. Me too.

I nap 16 hours a day. Sometimes more.
Not because I’m lazy, but because rest is natural.
Rest keeps me playful, calm, healthy.

Humans get tricked into thinking rest = laziness.
Nope. Rest = recharging your soft, magnificent self.

  • - Rest when you need it.
  • - Nap without guilt.
  • - Breathe without rushing.
  • - Sit in the sun and just be.

You are not a machine. You deserve to feel rested, not just “productive.”
